title: A Promise for the Postcard
author: Cyrus Joubert
blurb: Theo Hartwell, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must choose between the career that saved everything and the person who sees clearly at last, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
